title: WhisperWindowsV2
description:
A contiguous sequence with nonempty owned interiors. Deserialization is
admission: consumers cannot obtain a sequence with fabricated gaps or seams.

AudioPositionSeconds.description: A point in the audio, in finite non-negative seconds from its start.

FrameCountV2.description: Number of audio frames in a prepared artifact.

SampleRateHzV2.description: Audio sample rate in Hz carried by prepared artifacts.

WhisperChunkSpanV2.description:
One raw Whisper chunk as a producer emitted it: its words, and whichever
bounds the model reported.

Raw on purpose: a chunk may overlap its neighbour or arrive inverted, and
neither producer (the Python worker, the in-process whisper.cpp backend)
repairs that. The consumer does, once, through `MonotoneChunkSpans` in
`batchalign::worker::chunk_spans`; the only invariant the wire carries is
that a bound, when present, is a finite non-negative position in the
audio, which its type proves.

A bound is absent when the model predicted no timestamp for it: the
HuggingFace pipeline reports `(start, None)` for a chunk cut off
mid-word, and `(None, None)` for a whole transcript when timestamps were
suppressed. A missing bound is an absence of TIMING, never of words, and
the words travel untimed exactly as a Tencent or Aliyun word with a
missing offset does. Between 536f29c8 and this change such a chunk was
dropped, which emptied every Cantonese Whisper transcript.

end_s.description: End timestamp in seconds, when the model reported one.

start_s.description: Start timestamp in seconds, when the model reported one.

WhisperWindowV2.description: One independent decode. Timestamps are local to this window, not the file.

left_context.description: Left context shared with the preceding decode.

right_context.description: Right context shared with the following decode.

sample_count.description: Number of source samples, excluding model padding.

spans.description: Raw word or segment observations, never cross-window merged.

start_sample.description: First source sample observed by this decode.
